name: semantic-crosscheck
description: Cross-layer verification for an ontology plus semantic layer on PostgreSQL 17, for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Prove that a PostgreSQL closure, SHACL rules, OWL reasoning and a Cube model agree.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.10.0: cross-checks PostgreSQL 17 closures, SQL and SHACL rules, OWL/HermiT and Cube against gold SQL. Sampled V3, V4 replay and chunked pair checks require requested keys in the together and every alone response: confirmed disagreements fail, otherwise missing answers remain not_run without an incomplete-sample D95 claim. Generated shapes receive one sanitized shacl-shacl syntax-subset preflight before source export; invalid shapes block SHACL comparisons while independent OWL may proceed. Optional tlp --oracle norec independently compares WHERE and CASE/SUM counts over a bounded materialized relation, supports count(*) only and binds replay to its oracle. Existing configurations, default TLP and old TLP replay remain supported. Sparse standalone answers can conservatively remain unverified. Rerun build, reason, cube, verify and report after upgrading. No complete syntax, business correctness, shared MVCC snapshot, runtime attestation or operational V1-V5 promotion is claimed.
defaultPrompt: Use semantic-crosscheck to run the synthetic demo end to end.
Use semantic-crosscheck to verify my crosscheck.toml against PostgreSQL and explain what is not proven.
